verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a dedicated Client Credentials flow for M2M applications such as CLIs, daemons, and backend services, where the application rather than a user is authenticated. Apps exchange their Client ID and Secret for an Access Token, scoped M2M permissions are supported, and Auth0 positions per-agent identities for API access. A community comment referencing existing M2M setups loosely corroborates real-world use. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence of issuing and rotating M2M credentials, and explicit documentation tying client-credentials to agent workloads.
